original_question: N'ụbọchị Mọndee, Wenezdee, na Fraịdee, nwata akwụkwọ kọlej Kimo nwere klasị otu-awa atọ kwa ụbọchị. N'ụbọchị Tuzdee na Tọzdee, o nwere klasị awa abụọ otunaotu kwa ụbọchị.
